figures.shows: The Streaming panel's cell map of the Open World island a few seconds into the game's tour: the loaded cells around the player's dot, the blue circle of the farthest streaming distance, and the legend that counts each state
figures.caption: Seconds into the tour, orange loaded cells gather around the player's white dot. The blue circle is the farthest reach, Landmarks' 320 m; Vegetation stays loaded within 224 m. The legend counts three layers sharing squares; the island's northern rows lie above the map.
figures.alt: Orange squares around a white dot inside a blue circle cut at top and bottom, the rest dark gray, and a legend below with zero loading.
figures.numbers: From the world document Worlds/Island.stworld: three layers of 64 m cells, Vegetation 192 m (81 cells), Wildlife 128 m (10 cells), Landmarks 320 m (6 cells); 97 cells in all on 81 squares. Keep radius 192 + 32 = 224 m (the page's example). Measured on the take: cell pitch 29.5 px, circle 296 px across (321 m radius), map 250 px tall showing 7 of Vegetation's 10 rows, the 3 missing ones above it; legend Loaded 45, Unloaded 52.
